name: OmaCountdown
author: Suva
description: Elegant countdown timer to any custom date and time with configurable units, Omarchy Nerd Font glyphs, and dynamic green-to-red timeline gradient.

barWidget.description: Event countdown timer with customizable units and styling

schema.label: Active Countdown Index
schema.description: Index of the active countdown shown on the status bar.

schema.label: Event Title
schema.description: Title or label for the countdown event (e.g. 'NEET PG', 'Vacation').

schema.label: Target Date
schema.description: Target date in any format (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, 1 Aug 2027, +30d). If left empty, defaults to 7 days ahead.

schema.label: Start Date
schema.description: Timestamp when countdown was started, used for gradient timeline progression.

schema.label: Display Format
schema.description: Format on status bar: 'auto' (smart non-zero units), 'full' (all enabled units), 'compact' (top units), 'days_only' (total days), or 'percentage' (progress %).

schema.label: Show Years
schema.description: Include years in countdown calculations and display.

schema.label: Show Months
schema.description: Include months in countdown calculations and display.

schema.label: Show Weeks
schema.description: Include weeks in countdown calculations and display.

schema.label: Show Days
schema.description: Include days in countdown calculations and display.

schema.label: Show Event Title on Bar
schema.description: Display the event title before the countdown numbers on the status bar.

schema.label: Icon Style
schema.description: Prefix icon style following Omarchy Nerd Font theme typography.

schema.label: Custom Glyph / Text
schema.description: Custom Nerd Font glyph or text when iconStyle is 'custom'.

schema.label: Presentation Style
schema.description: Visual presentation: 'ghost' (plain text), 'accent_text' (gradient text), 'progress_track' (linear progress track with plain text), or 'dynamic_progress' (gradient text and linear progress track).

schema.label: Dynamic Timeline Gradient
schema.description: Smoothly transitions widget text and accent color from Green to Red as the deadline approaches.

schema.label: Urgent Warning Threshold (Days)
schema.description: Highlight widget in urgent theme color when remaining days are less than or equal to this threshold (0 to disable).
